name: microservices-backend
description: Node.js gRPC microservices backend with gRPC-Web proxy

scripts.start: concurrently --names proxy,svc-a,svc-b "npm --prefix grpc-web-proxy start" "npm --prefix services/service-a start" "npm --prefix services/service-b start"
scripts.dev: concurrently --names proxy,svc-a,svc-b "npm --prefix grpc-web-proxy run dev" "npm --prefix services/service-a run dev" "npm --prefix services/service-b run dev"
scripts.seed: npm --prefix services/service-a run seed && npm --prefix services/service-b run seed
scripts.seed:all: npm --prefix services/service-a run seed && npm --prefix services/service-b run seed && npm --prefix services/service-a run seed:products && npm --prefix services/service-b run seed:jobs
